observations: Two black game consoles stacked vertically.
The front of the top console shows a PlayStation logo and a vertical seam.
The console has a matte black finish with visible scratches and scuffs.
The console is sitting on a white plastic bag with 'McSteve' branding.
The background shows shelves with various mobile phone boxes (e.g., Samsung, Google, OnePlus).
No controllers, cables, or game discs are visible in the photos.

claims.evidence: The seller's location is not confirmed by the photos.
The console design, logo, and vertical seam are characteristic of the PS4 Pro.
No controllers are shown in the photos.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty HDMI port.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The controller may be missing or have a broken button.
risks.proof: A photo of the controller and a video of it being connected and used.

risks.risk: The disc drive may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video of a game disc being inserted and the game launching.
risks.if_unproven: as having a broken disc drive

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the console is online.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the console powering on and navigating the home screen.
Photo of the controller and any cables.
Video of a game disc being inserted and the game launching.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
